connectedStarterActivities.name: Track and release a seed-mouse
connectedStarterActivities.description: Follow tracks at the far landing; release the animal and collect one seed.

connectedStarterActivities.name: Open a commissioned lockbox
connectedStarterActivities.description: Halden’s permitted lockbox commission yields one garden seed.

connectedStarterActivities.name: Plant the herb bed
connectedStarterActivities.description: One seed grows for 30 seconds of connected play. Harvest for two herbs and 35 Farming XP.

connectedStarterActivities.name: Cook a river meal
connectedStarterActivities.description: One banked fish becomes a meal that heals 6 HP.

connectedStarterActivities.name: Smelt a lantern bar
connectedStarterActivities.description: One banked ore and log become one metal bar.

connectedStarterActivities.name: Assemble a lantern kit
connectedStarterActivities.description: One bar and banked log become a kit for settlement repairs.

connectedStarterActivities.name: Contribute a settlement repair
connectedStarterActivities.description: Spend one lantern kit; record one personal repair contribution. No player housing yet.

connectedStarterActivities.name: Fletch six reed arrows
connectedStarterActivities.description: One banked log becomes six arrows for the provided field bow.

connectedStarterActivities.name: Inscribe four field runes
connectedStarterActivities.description: One banked ore becomes four runes used by field spells. Runecrafting is its own skill.

connectedStarterActivities.name: Brew a restorative tonic
connectedStarterActivities.description: One harvested herb becomes a potion that heals 8 HP.

connectedStarterActivities.name: Fuel the settlement hearth
connectedStarterActivities.description: One banked log keeps the hearth warm for 30 seconds; nearby meals heal 2 extra HP.

connectedStarterActivities.name: Offer earned Warden essence
connectedStarterActivities.description: Offer one banked essence to refill Prayer; active protection reduces incoming damage by 1.
